title: Laila ka Chand
body:
laila ka chand doob gaya qatlgaah mein
ab roshni nahi shahe deen ki nigaah mein
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki laash dhoodne nikle hai shaahe deen
har har qadam pe thokarein khaate hai raah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e ahlebait ke baazu jo kat gaye
darya lahoo ka beh gaya pyason ki chaah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon ke aage bhai ka sar tan se kat gaya
zainab pachadein khaati rahi qatlgaah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek laash ghar mein laaye to ek laash le gaye
din kat gaya hussain ka faryad o aah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
milta nahi qaraar kisi jaa hussain ko
hai qaimagaah mein to kabhi qatlgaah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dam gulu e asghar e baysheer chid gaya
na jaane kitne teer chube qalbe shaah mein
laila ka chand...
author: Yawar Azmi
